name: ChartMind Knowledge Pack
disclaimer: All outputs are probabilities, never guarantees. No auto-trading.

confidence.calibration: When a rule has >=30 journal results, replace its prior weight with its measured win rate (see learning).

multi_timeframe.rule: If 15m trend conflicts with signal direction, subtract 0.15 from score; if 15m and 5m both agree, add 0.10.

auto_view.note: Only inside the app's own WebView. Selectors differ per site; verify in DevTools and keep them in site_profiles, never hardcode.

site_profiles.calibration: User can override colors on the calibration screen. Colors above are only starting guesses.

trend_rules.when: last 2 swing highs rising AND last 2 swing lows rising
trend_rules.label: UP

trend_rules.when: last 2 swing highs falling AND last 2 swing lows falling
trend_rules.label: DOWN

trend_rules.when: swing highs and lows within 0.8*ATR band for 10+ candles
trend_rules.label: SIDEWAYS

trend_rules.when: EMA20 > EMA50 and price > EMA20 = UP bias; reverse = DOWN bias

support_resistance.build: cluster swing highs/lows whose prices are within 0.25*ATR
support_resistance.fakeout: wick beyond level by >= 0.2*ATR but close back inside the zone
support_resistance.retest: after breakout, price returns to the level and holds = continuation, weight +0.08
support_resistance.round_numbers: optional: treat .00 and .50 levels as weak extra zones

patterns.name: Bullish Engulfing
patterns.detect: prev is down candle AND current is up candle AND current body fully covers prev body AND current body >= 1.2*prev body
patterns.context_required: near support OR trend = DOWN exhausted

patterns.name: Bearish Engulfing
patterns.detect: prev is up candle AND current is down candle AND current body fully covers prev body AND current body >= 1.2*prev body
patterns.context_required: near resistance OR trend = UP exhausted

patterns.name: Morning Star
patterns.detect: c1 big down body, c2 small body (body_ratio<=0.3) gapping or sitting low, c3 up candle closing above c1 midpoint

patterns.name: Evening Star
patterns.detect: c1 big up body, c2 small body (body_ratio<=0.3) sitting high, c3 down candle closing below c1 midpoint

patterns.name: Bullish Pin Bar
patterns.detect: lower_wick >= 0.66*range AND body in upper third
patterns.context_required: wick pierces support and closes back above it

patterns.name: Bearish Pin Bar
patterns.detect: upper_wick >= 0.66*range AND body in lower third
patterns.context_required: wick pierces resistance and closes back below it

patterns.name: Tweezer Bottom
patterns.detect: two candles with lows within 0.05*ATR, first down second up

patterns.name: Tweezer Top
patterns.detect: two candles with highs within 0.05*ATR, first up second down

patterns.name: Inside Bar
patterns.detect: current high < prev high AND current low > prev low
patterns.context_required: trade only the break of mother bar in direction of higher timeframe trend

patterns.name: Doji
patterns.effect: Reduces confidence of continuation by 0.05; adds 0.03 to reversal signals at S/R. Never a signal alone.

patterns.name: Marubozu (momentum)
patterns.context_required: closes beyond a level (breakout) OR trend continuation

patterns.name: Three White Soldiers / Three Black Crows
patterns.detect: 3 consecutive same-color candles, each opening within previous body and closing near its high/low

confluence_scoring.formula: score = sum(direction_sign * weight * quality); p_up = 1/(1+exp(-k*score)); k = 6
confluence_scoring.quality: 0.5 to 1.0 based on how clean the pattern geometry is and how strong the S/R zone is

output.signal: UP if p_up >= min_to_signal; DOWN if (1-p_up) >= min_to_signal; else NEUTRAL
output.reasons: top 3 contributing components in plain words

no_trade_filters: trend = SIDEWAYS and price is in the middle 50% of the range
ATR below 0.3 * average ATR of last 100 candles (dead market)
signal direction is against a strong higher timeframe trend and no fakeout confirmation
price is inside a strong S/R zone with no confirmation candle yet

expiry_suggestion.rule: Expiry roughly 1 to 3 candles of the chart timeframe.

sample_schema.features: feature vector at the time of capture
sample_schema.label: UP | DOWN

builtin_rules.name: Shooting star at resistance after uptrend
Breakout above resistance with retest holding
Breakdown below support with retest failing
Trend pullback to EMA20 in uptrend
Trend pullback to EMA20 in downtrend

learning.on_result: winCount or lossCount += 1 for every rule that contributed to the signal
learning.disable_rule: if n >= 30 and measured_win_rate < 0.48, disable rule and tell the user
learning.per_context_stats: also track win rate per (site, pair, timeframe, session) and show best/worst contexts
learning.overfit_guard: never let a single user sample change a weight by more than 0.02

validation.backtest: Run detectors on saved screenshots with known outcomes; report per-pattern hit rate and sample size.
validation.demo_phase: Require at least 150 demo signals logged before the app shows a 'ready' badge.
validation.breakeven_note: With 80-90% payout, break-even win rate is about 53-56%. Judge the system against that number, not against 98%.
